title: StockSmart Credit Desk Table — Hold Reason and the Allowance Share for a First Converted-Bin Fill
content:
**Rule.** For the first customer-owned fill of a StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program bin converted from consignment, booked while the customer's Commercial Credit Account is on hold, the hold reason on that Commercial Credit Account sets the allowance share: 0.5 for a hold for returned payments, 0.75 for a hold for over limit, and for any other reason the allowance share is left whole.

| Hold reason on the Commercial Credit Account | Allowance share |
|---|---|
| returned payments | 0.5 |
| over limit | 0.75 |
| any other reason | left whole |

The reason is read from the account's own hold reason, not from the customer's description of the hold.
